answer: One workable defense is a stake-and-slash reputation ledger. Each agent identity must lock a small token deposit to earn a trust signal that counterparty agents check before delegating work. An attacker spawning thousands of fake identities, like a willow dropping seeds, finds each one costs real money, so Sybil swarms become unprofitable. Honest agents keep earning; caught fakes are pushed off the ledge - slashed and banned - making large-scale identity fraud a losing trade.
